title: Model 3 island and coastal stretch recovery results
summary: In a disclosed second look, island v3 had 154, 155, 151, and 149 positives at 2, 3, 5, and 7 days, with zero negatives at every horizon, leaving AUC evidence insufficient. For coastal stretch, the primary 7-day comparison on n=419 had v3 AUC 0.59556 versus climatology K 0.50798, a delta of +0.08759 with 95% interval [-0.02779, 0.14468], which is inconclusive. The descriptive 2-day comparison on n=431 had delta +0.11593 with interval [0.02681, 0.17622].
scope: Aggregate Model 3 island and coastal stretch risk comparisons in the previously exposed June-September 2026 recovery cohort.

limitations: This is a DISCLOSED SECOND LOOK on a previously exposed June-September 2026 cohort, not independent confirmation, a fresh holdout, or confirmatory evidence.
Island risk has zero negatives at each reported horizon, so its AUC evidence is insufficient.

Under the signed label definition, an island positive is any occupied zone cell even if eligibility is false; a negative requires at least 80% eligible coverage. These semantics and seasonal prevalence limit interpretation as natural prevalence.
The primary coastal stretch 7-day interval includes zero and is inconclusive.
The 2-day coastal stretch result is descriptive, not the primary comparison.
